lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, with narrower spacing observed at the anterior and posterior extremities of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the second line from the anterior, which merges with the third line at approximately 40% height from the ventral line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 9, 10, and 11 from the anterior exhibit mid-segment discontinuities, appearing as dashed or truncated segments that fail to reach the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density cluster of 4 distinct white spots located on the lower posterior haunch, superior to the hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of three circular spots across the mid-thigh region.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark pigment patch at the base of the tail and a white transverse throat patch visible on the lower neck.
